title: To the Stars material testing with military labs halted by COVID
place_text: To the Stars Academy / US military laboratories

tellings.quote: We know that we were getting close to something. We were developing relationships with the military with their laboratories >> to do the kind of testing only they could do. >> And then COVID hit. >> When COVID hit, all the relationship with the military really stopped.

plain: In 2019 and 2020, To the Stars Academy, a company set up to research UFOs and the materials said to come from them, was building ties with US military laboratories to run tests on those materials that "only they could do," until the COVID pandemic stopped it. The author Peter Levenda, who says he was part of the effort, tells it this way: "We know that we were getting close to something," and then "all the relationship with the military really stopped."
